answer: An attacker running 130 aliases hence needs 69 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are logged in reef, expire in crystal, and haven lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1364 identities would post 2868 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
